sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 210 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 247 of 251 campsites + 21 cabins parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; 1-night stays allowed for campsites. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. Cabins have 7-night (peak) and 2-night minimums.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cayuga-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=210 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'This campground allows 1-night stays for campsites only'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park says some loops may open later or close earlier.

season.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cayuga-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=210 ('Cayuga Lake State Park - 2027 Camping Season Campsites*: Friday, May 14, 2027 - Monday, October 11, 2027 *Some loops may open later/close earlier'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 34 electric (30-amp) sites, all in the East Electric loop; the other ten loops have none. No full hookups.

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 210 ('Electric Hookup available: 30 amp' 34, all 'East Electric'; 'Electric Hookup - no' 213; 'Full Hookup - no' 247), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 251 campsites in eleven loops plus 21 cabins, all back-in; most are listed at 20 ft (158 of 247 parsed), 41 at 30 ft and 6 at 40 ft (four in the 800 Loop, two in East Electric).

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cayuga-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=210 ('Campsite (251)', 'Cabin (21)') + ReserveAmerica site list ('20 Back-In' 158, '30 Back-In' 41, 'Back-In' 37, '40 Back-In' 6, '10 Back-In' 5), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cayuga-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=210 ('a dump station ... and showers'; Services and Amenities 'Bath House', 'Dump Station'), read 2026-10-21

note: OPRHP on the west shore at the north end of Cayuga Lake, east of Seneca Falls. Campsites sit uphill from the beach and lawns; some East Camp sites have a lake view. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 210): reservable, phone 315-568-5163, 30-amp electric (34 sites, East Electric loop), 40-ft max, dump, 2027 season May 14 - Oct 11 with the some-loops caveat. Changed site count 283 -> 251 (RA's campsite count; the note's ~283 likely included cabins/other units). Added 9-month window incl. same day, 1-night stays allowed, 14-night max, no pull-throughs, showers. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of site/electric/length/booking text.
flags: Minor: most sites are listed at 20 ft (158 of 247 parsed); a 23-ft rig should pick from the 47 listed at 30-40 ft or the 37 with no length.
